name: HumidorLocation
description: A humidor or storage location used to track cigars in a user's CigarKeeper collection.

name.description: Name or label for this humidor location

humidor_type.description: Type of humidor or storage container

capacity_count.description: Maximum number of cigars this humidor can hold

current_count.description: Current number of cigars stored in this humidor

target_humidity_rh.description: Target relative humidity percentage (e.g. 65 for 65% RH)

target_temp_f.description: Target storage temperature in degrees Fahrenheit

last_humidity_reading.description: Most recent actual humidity reading (% RH)

last_reading_date.description: Date of the most recent humidity/temperature reading (YYYY-MM-DD)

last_maintenance_date.description: Date humidor was last maintained or checked (YYYY-MM-DD)

last_humidity_aid_date.description: Date humidification aid (Boveda, beads, etc.) was last replaced or recharged (YYYY-MM-DD)

maintenance_interval_days.description: Target maintenance interval in days (e.g. 30 for monthly checks)

notes.description: Free-text notes about this humidor location

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record

created_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was created

updated_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was last updated
